verdict.rationale: IP India is an online filing, search and status-tracking portal, and such a service could plausibly offer scheduled watches or background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only user-initiated actions: e-filing, public search, manual status lookups, cause lists and journals. Nothing documents user-configurable automations, scheduled jobs or recurring background runs, and the llms.txt probe returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
